proposals.missing_context: Viewer may not know who Catherine and Rupert are or why they covet the ducal crown.
proposals.why: The taunting opening grabs attention and the promise of peasants learning their place leaves a dangerous power grab unresolved.

proposals.missing_context: Viewer may not know who Alexander is or why his death matters to Rupert’s claim.
proposals.why: Rupert’s cold declaration about Alexander’s death shocks the viewer, and the threat to the Dowager’s life ends on a deadly deadline.

proposals.missing_context: Viewer may not know the village’s lung fever crisis or why Juliana is the only healer.
proposals.why: Juliana’s fierce declaration of stakes hooks the audience, and her final “I am not finished” leaves her next move unknown.
